notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Kinnan triggers, adding one mana of the color that was produced.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
